corrections.detail: QA-CONSOLE-05 downgraded from passed to partial: it bypassed the interactive command loop. Two console defects were found by the critic and are being fixed: (D-1) the command loop cannot read input while its own submit is in flight, so /gate and steering are unreachable during a turn; (D-2) prompt redraw can erase multi-call rendered frames including assistant text and gate ids.

Refreshed to the console correctness generation: QA-CONSOLE-05 restored to passed now that interactive gate answering runs through the real command loop, and six new cases added covering the two terminal-critic findings, the leader-found exit-drain regression, and the three follow-on blockers (echo/frame atomicity, bounded exit, input never dropped).
